name: Multicam Generator
summary: Choose a model and camera angle, generate with original-speech lip sync, and automatically add a separate editable clip to your Draft.

compatibility.selects: Tested in Selects Staging 2.0.443 on macOS. Requires Panel SDK askAI (including image attachments), runScript, managed media generation, and internal timeline/filesystem/FFmpeg adapters. Native Omni generation requires MediaGeneration service support (host 2.0.433+). Other builds and platforms are unverified.
